name: When is the best time of year to start a living space renovation project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a living space renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 'best' time to start a renovation often depends on personal preference and project scope. Many homeowners prefer to begin in spring or early summer to allow for completion before the holiday season. This can also be advantageous for projects that might involve outdoor work or require natural light for certain tasks. However, off-peak seasons might offer more flexibility with contractor scheduling. Opus Builders works year-round and can accommodate projects to fit your optimal timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spring or early summer are popular times to start renovations to finish before holidays, but projects can begin anytime based on preference and contractor availability.
